name: Yadavindra Gardens Restaurant (Haryana Tourism)
why_it_matters: The on-site restaurant inside Yadavindra Gardens, run by Haryana Tourism. The only sit-down option without leaving the Mughal-garden complex — table with terrace view of the seven garden levels.
insider_tip: Wait for sunset; the Mughal terrace fountains turn on at 7pm in summer and the restaurant garden-side seating frames them. Skip à la carte and do the lunch buffet for value.
signature_address: Yadavindra Gardens, Pinjore, Panchkula District, Haryana 134102

name: Khalsa Dhaba
why_it_matters: Highway dhaba about 5 km from Pinjore Gardens on the Kalka stretch — the standard Chandigarh-Shimla pause where car families stop for parathas-and-chai before climbing into the hills.
insider_tip: Charpai seating in the back garden runs cooler than the AC indoor hall in summer afternoons; ask for the lassi to be set in a kulhad rather than the standard glass.
signature_address: Pinjore-Kalka Highway, near Pinjore Gardens, Panchkula District, Haryana 134102

name: Budhanpur Highway Dhaba
why_it_matters: One of the dhaba clusters on the Chandigarh-Shimla highway between Pinjore and Kalka — truck-driver-tested, tandoori chicken served whole, prices set by the highway not the tourism corridor.
insider_tip: If you're driving up to Shimla after Pinjore, this is the last reliable Punjabi tandoor stop before the road climbs; hill-side dhabas above Kalka switch to Himachali snack menus.
signature_address: Chandigarh-Shimla Highway, Pinjore, Panchkula District, Haryana 134102
